stem: An unimmunised immunocompetent child was exposed to chickenpox yesterday. What is the most appropriate post-exposure intervention?
explanation: Susceptible immunocompetent contacts can receive varicella vaccine after exposure if given promptly. Varicella-zoster immunoglobulin is reserved for selected high-risk susceptible contacts.
rationale: Susceptible immunocompetent contacts can receive varicella vaccine after exposure if given promptly. Varicella-zoster immunoglobulin is reserved for selected high-risk susceptible contacts.
